release_rule: Live money requires system coherence, owner independence, production runtime readiness, commercial owner locks, applicable legal/compliance approvals, and verified single-runtime ownership of the live domain. A technically working deployment is not permission to process live money.

transaction_state_axes.invariant: ACCOUNTED is an integrity/completeness state. PROTECTED is a record/revenue classification. They are different axes and must never be treated as synonyms.

revenue_contract.carry_rule: A transaction's exact fee entitlement is attributed in micros only after the transaction becomes PROTECTED. Only whole cents are placed on a Stripe application fee. A residual smaller than one cent from a PROTECTED transaction accrues to the merchant carry ledger and may be reserved before a later checkout. Reserved prior carry is SETTLED only when that later payment itself becomes PROTECTED; a fee-exception reservation remains releasable. Later carry settlement is cash collection of prior fee entitlement, not new fee entitlement for the later transaction.
revenue_contract.protection_rule: PROTECTED requires the Builtegrity-controlled route, required customer jurisdiction attestation and pre-checkout legal-gate evidence, successful payment history, and processor-confirmed gross application fee exactly matching the locked whole-cent current-transaction fee plus any valid reserved prior carry collected on that payment.
revenue_contract.processor_truth_rule: Real processor payment/fee facts must still be recorded even if a legal or protection prerequisite is missing. Missing pre-checkout legal evidence blocks PROTECTED promotion and routes the record to review; it must not cause truthful Stripe webhook data to be rejected or discarded.
revenue_contract.entitlement_vs_cash_rule: Exact transaction-fee entitlement belongs to the originating PROTECTED transaction in micros. Processor application-fee cash is a separate whole-cent fact and may include prior carry settlement. Cash-basis books may reconcile the latter without re-attributing prior carry as new entitlement.

pricing.note: Implemented in test/pre-launch code and public draft copy, but deliberately not represented as owner-locked until the owner explicitly locks the commercial schedule.

platform_fee_refund_economics.note: The machine supports stricter full/pro-rata refund handlers. Live treatment must be both owner-locked and counsel/jurisdiction approved; unknown law fails closed.

financial_safety.policy: Runtime financial evidence is authoritative. Unknown or stale evidence fails closed for affected growth/payment actions.

source_control.note: The connected GitHub App can build and merge through PRs but cannot configure repository administration. main branch protection/ruleset and required CI must be enabled and independently verified before LIVE.

deployment_ownership.note: GitHub Pages currently owns the root custom domain as a temporary static pre-launch shell. It must not expose transaction-console/payment routes or publish internal repository directories. Before LIVE, builtegrity.com must be verified on the Cloudflare Worker/Static Assets runtime and GitHub Pages custom-domain ownership must be retired or moved away from the live domain.

migration_lineage.rule: Never rename, delete, or edit a migration already frozen in the baseline. Correct historical schema mistakes with a new migration. Duplicate numeric prefixes are forbidden after the frozen lineage.

canonical_sources.database_schema: migrations/*.sql in lexical order, protected by migration-lineage immutability
canonical_sources.temporary_pages_shell: root index.html + styles.css + 404.html + static legal/privacy documents, bounded by _config.yml
canonical_sources.note: The GitHub Pages shell and Cloudflare application intentionally have different entry points. Only static legal documents may be mirrored. Standalone schema snapshots, divergent legal copies, and duplicate application deployments are forbidden.

legal_authority.counsel_role: Qualified outside lawyer or law firm retained by Builtegrity under an active engagement. No provider is currently selected merely because the role exists in code.
legal_authority.registered_agent_role: Receives formal service/process and forwards it into the legal-response route.
legal_authority.insurer_role: Receives policy/claim notices when counsel or an approved coverage procedure requires notice.
legal_authority.ai_role: Automation, evidence preservation, routing, monitoring and operational assistance only; never legal authority or counsel.
